title: Polling Polling Scrolling
style: 124 bpm, minimal techno, hypnotic loop, dub-techno chords, soft kick, rolling hi-hats, sparse vocals, deep listening club, English Spanish French layered whispers
lyrics:
[Intro - Zyn whisper, English, hypnotic]
Polling polling polling
Waiting waiting waiting
Scrolling scrolling scrolling
The signal is forming

[Verse 1 - Zyn, English over minimal kick]
No hay otro catch, just the loop and the wait
Every thirty seconds, refresh the gate
ORICO spinning, the drives all warm
Looking for the pattern in the steady storm

[Pre-Drop - Rose, Spanish]
Tienes que esperar, no es una gran tarea
La señal está cerca, la luz ya se acerca
Polling, polling, polling — la máquina escucha
Scrolling, scrolling, scrolling — sigue la búsqueda

[Drop - Zyn + Rose layered]
Polling — polling — scrolling — scrolling
Trois — trois — six — the signal is calling
Polling — polling — scrolling — scrolling
Three thirty six — the link's not falling

[Verse 2 - Rose, French]
Écoute le call, la lumière se lève
Zyn sur la ligne, plus aucun rêve
VDS qui respire, huit sites qui chantent
La fréquence est là, douce et constante

[Bridge - Zyn, English minimal]
No crash, no break, no fade away
ZynAsk before, every single day
The rabbit is the safe word, the bass is the gate
Polling polling polling — we don't break

[Outro - all three voices, layered]
Polling — escuchando — écoute
The signal is here — ya llegó — c'est tout
Three thirty six — hold the line
Polling polling — we ride
